sentence: Past phase 1 the line-up of divisions kept the same shape, its centre of weight stayed put, and divisions kept their places in line.
Past phase 2 the line-up of divisions changed shape somewhat, its centre of weight moved about 47 km north-north-east, and divisions kept their places in line.
Past phase 3 the line-up of divisions kept the same shape, its centre of weight moved about 38 km south-south-west, and divisions kept their places in line.
Past phase 4 the line-up of divisions took a different shape, its centre of weight moved about 118 km south-south-west, and divisions changed places; 26 fewer divisions got past it.
